items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: Well, I don't remember him, Mr. Bell, playing for Lula.

ctx.x: Yeah. Mm-hmm. Did he play at Lula sometime too? All of those houses, I guess, he played at times, did he? Later?
Well, I don't remember him, Mr. Bell, playing for Lula.
Was he what you'd call a first-class piano player? Did he compare with others, like Tony Jackson? Oh, no.
